advancements.meridian.root.title: Meridian
advancements.meridian.root.description: Collect any Meridian shelf to start shaping your enchanting stats.
advancements.meridian.stone_tier.title: Stone Foundations
advancements.meridian.stone_tier.descrip: Craft a Hellshelf, Seashelf, or Dormant Deepshelf to begin Eterna progression.
advancements.meridian.tier_three.title: Infused Mastery
advancements.meridian.tier_three.descrip: Craft an Infused Hellshelf, Infused Seashelf, or Deepshelf through the stat-gated table.
advancements.meridian.library.title: The Enchantment Library
advancements.meridian.library.descriptio: Craft an Enchantment Library to pool enchanted books by level.
advancements.meridian.ender_library.desc: Upgrade the Library to an Ender Library at the enchanting table.
advancements.meridian.tome_apprentice.de: Craft a Scrap Tome to salvage enchantments from any tool or weapon.
advancements.meridian.tome_master.title: Tome Master
advancements.meridian.tome_master.descri: Craft an Extraction Tome to pull every enchantment without destroying the item.
advancements.meridian.warden_tendril.des: Claim a Warden Tendril from the depths — required for sculk-tier shelves.
advancements.meridian.infused_breath.des: Refine Dragon's Breath into Infused Breath at a high-Eterna table.
advancements.meridian.apotheosis.title: Apotheosis
advancements.meridian.apotheosis.descrip: Reach maximum enchanting power — hit Eterna 50 and take the top-slot enchant.
advancements.meridian.sculk_mastery.desc: Craft an Echoing or Soul-Touched Sculkshelf — the pinnacle of enchanting power.
Craft a Rectifier shelf to gain control over enchantment stability.
advancements.meridian.all_seeing.title: All-Seeing
advancements.meridian.all_seeing.descrip: Craft a Hellshelf of Masterful Sight to reveal all enchantment clues.
advancements.meridian.curator.title: The Curator
advancements.meridian.curator.descriptio: Craft a Filtering Shelf to blacklist unwanted enchantments from your table.
advancements.meridian.treasure_seeker.de: Craft a Treasure Shelf to unlock treasure-tier enchantments at the table.
advancements.meridian.web_spinner.title: Web Spinner
advancements.meridian.web_spinner.descri: Obtain a Prismatic Web — the key to removing curses from enchanted gear.
advancements.meridian.high_quanta.title: Chaotic Enchanter
advancements.meridian.high_quanta.descri: Enchant an item with Quanta above 60 — embrace the chaos.
advancements.meridian.high_arcana.title: Arcane Scholar
advancements.meridian.high_arcana.descri: Enchant an item with Arcana above 60 — command the rarest enchantments.
